writing:or:94.hint: 何年もの間なかった出来事が久しぶりに起きたことを表す構文は何か。
writing:or:94.question: It snowed heavily [[to]] the first time in ten years.
writing:or:94.fullSentence: It snowed heavily for the first time in ten years.

writing:or:95.hint: 現在の事実に反して、もしそれがなければと仮定する構文は何か。
writing:or:95.question: If it were not [[to]] his help, I could not finish this work.
writing:or:95.fullSentence: If it were not for his help, I could not finish this work.
writing:or:95.explanation: 現在の事実に反する仮定を表す構文。

writing:or:96.hint: 実現が難しい願望を、まるでそれができたらいいのにと表す構文は何か。
writing:or:96.fullSentence: I wish I could speak French fluently.
writing:or:96.explanation: 現在の願望を表す仮定法。

writing:or:97.hint: 現実とは異なる様子を、まるでそうであったかのように表す構文は何か。
writing:or:97.fullSentence: He talked as if he had seen the accident himself.
writing:or:97.explanation: 過去の事実に反する様子を表す構文。

writing:or:98.hint: 過去にしなかったことを今悔やんでいる、という構文は何か。
writing:or:98.fullSentence: She regretted not having studied harder in high school.
writing:or:98.explanation: ~しなかったことを後悔する構文。

writing:or:99.hint: 二つの物事を比べて、一方が他方ほどではないと述べる構文は何か。
writing:or:99.question: It is not as difficult [[for]] learn Spanish as to learn Japanese.
writing:or:99.fullSentence: It is not as difficult to learn Spanish as to learn Japanese.

writing:or:100.hint: 以前と比べて人々の行動の量が変化したことを表す構文は何か。
writing:or:100.question: People do not spend as much time reading books as they used [[for]].
writing:or:100.fullSentence: People do not spend as much time reading books as they used to.
writing:or:100.explanation: 以前ほど~しない、という構文。

writing:or:101.hint: ある基準の何倍もの量であることを表す構文は何か。
writing:or:101.fullSentence: I have about five times as many books as my sister.

writing:or:102.hint: 予想していた基準より実際の程度が上回っていたことを表す構文は何か。
writing:or:102.fullSentence: The exam was much more difficult than I had expected.
writing:or:102.explanation: 予想していたより、という比較の構文。

writing:or:103.hint: メールを書き始める際に相手の近況を気遣う定型的な一文は何か。
writing:or:103.question: I hope this email [[find]] you well.
writing:or:103.fullSentence: I hope this email finds you well.
writing:or:103.explanation: メールの書き出しの定型句。

writing:or:104.hint: メールの目的をこれから述べる、という書き出しの構文は何か。
writing:or:104.question: I am writing [[for]] discuss my missed midterm exam.
writing:or:104.fullSentence: I am writing to discuss my missed midterm exam.
writing:or:104.explanation: メールの目的を伝える定型構文。

writing:or:105.hint: 医師の診断結果を証明する文書を受け取ったことを伝える一文は何か。
writing:or:105.fullSentence: I have visited the doctor, who provided me with a medical certificate.
writing:or:105.explanation: 診断書を提供してもらったという表現。

writing:or:106.hint: 都合の良い日に再試験の機会を設けてほしいと依頼する一文は何か。
writing:or:106.question: I would like to request an opportunity [[for]] take a makeup exam at your convenience.
writing:or:106.fullSentence: I would like to request an opportunity to take a makeup exam at your convenience.
writing:or:106.explanation: 再試験の機会を依頼する定型表現。

writing:or:107.hint: 自分の成績が努力と能力を反映したものになることを望むという一文は何か。
writing:or:107.question: I am eager [[for]] demonstrate that my grade reflects my efforts and capabilities.
writing:or:107.fullSentence: I am eager to demonstrate that my grade reflects my efforts and capabilities.
writing:or:107.explanation: 熱望しているという意味の表現。

writing:or:108.hint: 相手の配慮に感謝を伝える定型的な一文は何か。
writing:or:108.fullSentence: Thank you very much for your consideration of my situation.
writing:or:108.explanation: 配慮への感謝を伝える定型句。

writing:or:109.hint: 返信を楽しみに待っていることを伝えるメールの結びの一文は何か。
writing:or:109.question: I look forward [[for]] hearing from you.
writing:or:109.fullSentence: I look forward to hearing from you.
writing:or:109.explanation: メールの結びの定型句。

writing:or:110.hint: 他に必要な対応があれば教えてほしいと伝える一文は何か。
writing:or:110.question: Please let me know if there [[are]] anything else I need to do.
writing:or:110.fullSentence: Please let me know if there is anything else I need to do.
writing:or:110.explanation: 追加対応の確認を促す表現。

writing:or:111.hint: 相手からのメールに対して感謝を伝える書き出しの表現は何か。
writing:or:111.explanation: メールへの返信の書き出し。

writing:or:112.hint: 相手の近況を聞いて嬉しく思うという気持ちを伝える表現は何か。
writing:or:112.question: I am pleased [[for]] hear that you passed the exam.
writing:or:112.fullSentence: I am pleased to hear that you passed the exam.
writing:or:112.explanation: 嬉しい気持ちを伝える定型構文。

writing:or:113.hint: 自分の意見を支える理由が複数あることを述べる一文は何か。
writing:or:113.question: I have two reasons [[to]] the following opinion.
writing:or:113.fullSentence: I have two reasons for the following opinion.
writing:or:113.explanation: 意見を支える理由を導入する表現。

writing:or:114.hint: ある単語が二つの語の短縮形であることを説明する構文は何か。
writing:or:114.fullSentence: This word is a contracted form of two other words.
writing:or:114.explanation: 短縮形であることを説明する表現。

writing:or:115.hint: 文章の締めくくりに使う、心を込めた結びの言葉は何か。
writing:or:115.explanation: 手紙・メールの結びの言葉。

writing:or:116.hint: ある事実について、明らかにそうだと強く述べる書き出しの語は何か。
writing:or:116.fullSentence: Certainly, technology has changed the way we communicate.
writing:or:116.explanation: 明らかに、という強調の副詞。

writing:or:117.hint: ある意見が事実として広く認められていることを述べる構文は何か。
writing:or:117.question: It [[are]] true that online classes offer more flexibility.
writing:or:117.fullSentence: It is true that online classes offer more flexibility.
writing:or:117.explanation: ~というのは事実だ、という構文。

writing:or:118.hint: 反対の立場の意見をあえて紹介する際に使う構文は何か。
writing:or:118.fullSentence: Some people will argue that traditional classes are more effective.
writing:or:118.explanation: 反対意見を紹介する構文。
